title: Weekend hours and branch visits in Harrowmere Valley
statement: Extending Saturday and Sunday opening hours at Harrowmere Valley Library District branches increased weekend visits at those branches.
disproof: Weekend visits at the extended-hours branches did not rise compared with the same months a year earlier, or rose no more than at branches whose hours did not change.
questions: Which branches extended their weekend hours, and from what date?
Did any branch report flat or falling weekend visits after the change?
